definitions.explanation: A person who belongs to a club, organization, or service.

examples.japanese: {会員|かいいん}になると{割引|わりびき}が{受|う}けられます。
examples.english: If you become a member, you can receive discounts.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}です。
examples.english: This store is for members only.

examples.japanese: {会員|かいいん}{登録|とうろく}をしたいのですが。
examples.english: I would like to register as a member.

notes:
{会員|かいいん} means member, typically of a club, organization, or membership service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会員|かいいん}になる (to become a member)
- {会員|かいいん}{登録|とうろく} (membership registration)
- {会員|かいいん}{証|しょう} (membership card)
- {会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい} (members only)
- {会員|かいいん}{番号|ばんごう} (member number)
- {年会費|ねんかいひ} (annual membership fee)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {正会員|せいかいいん} (regular/full member)
- {準会員|じゅんかいいん} (associate member)
- {新規会員|しんきかいいん} (new member)

COUNTER: {人|にん} or {名|めい}
